about: C2b critic: two_ways and door with the hands off, every living man's yaw traced each frame; around each 'spin' event, his yaw, state, place and path dumped (where the full turn comes from)

steps.eval: (window.YT = [], window.YTF = () => { for (const [h, ai] of G.ais) if (h.alive) { const S = ai.brain && ai.brain.S; YT.push([+G.time.toFixed(3), h.slot, +h.yaw.toFixed(3), +h.pos.x.toFixed(2), +h.pos.z.toFixed(2), S && S.state, h.state, ai.path ? ai.pathI + '/' + ai.path.length : '-', +(h.speed || 0).toFixed(2), G.scenes.beat]); } if (YT.length > 200000) YT.splice(0, 50000); }, G.scripts.push(YTF), 1)

(() => { const ev = G.guns.events.filter((e) => e.what === 'spin'); return ev.map((e) => { const near = YT.filter((r) => r[0] > e.t - 3 && r[0] <= e.t + 0.2 && Math.hypot(r[3] - e.at[0], r[4] - e.at[1]) < 3); const slots = [...new Set(near.map((r) => r[1]))]; return slots.map((s) => { const R = YT.filter((r) => r[1] === s && r[0] > e.t - 3 && r[0] <= e.t + 0.3); return R.filter((r, i) => i % 6 === 0).map((r) => r.join(' ')).join(' | '); }); }); })()
